status.summary: Retired from MMA. He announced his retirement in the cage after losing a unanimous decision to Gilbert Burns at UFC 287 in Miami (Apr 8, 2023), his fourth straight loss. He then lost a majority decision to Nate Diaz in a boxing match (Jul 6, 2024). He runs the Gamebred bare-knuckle MMA promotion. Age 41. No MMA bout appears in the UFC Stats snapshot of Oct 31, 2026. Comeback talk, bookings and any 2025-26 news were NOT verified this session (web search budget used up; Wikipedia and ufc.com blocked).
sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jorge_Masvidal (reference for the retirement, the Diaz boxing match and Gamebred; not reachable this session, so unverified)

signature: flying knee: knocked out Ben Askren at 0:05 of round 1 (UFC 239, Jul 6, 2019), widely reported as the fastest KO in UFC history
one-punch power at distance: knocked out Darren Till at 3:05 of round 2 in London (Mar 16, 2019); 0.46 knockdowns per 15 min career (welterweight median 0.35)

body punches and body kicks: 24% of his landed significant strikes go to the body (league welterweight about 21%); 35 of 39 vs Benson Henderson (2015), 29 vs Kamaru Usman (UFC 251), and the body-punch finish of Donald Cerrone (2017)
elbows and knees in the clinch: elbow KO of Cezar Ferreira in the clinch (2015); 17% of his landed significant strikes come in the clinch
finishing on the ground: 2 knockdowns and 40 ground strikes landed vs Nate Diaz before the doctor stoppage at UFC 244
low kicks late in his career: 17 of 19 leg strikes vs Burns, 19 of 27 vs Colby Covington, 15 of 15 vs Usman at UFC 261
weaknesses: held down by elite welterweight wrestlers: Usman had 16:38 of control at UFC 251, Covington 16:14 at UFC 272 and Burns 5:41 at UFC 287; opponents controlled him for 41% of his recency-weighted minutes
output collapses late in five-round fights: pace by round relative to round 1 is 1.00 / 1.19 / 0.85 / 0.61 / 0.23; vs Usman he landed 24, 20, 12, 6 and 4 significant strikes by round
knocked out by an Usman right hand at 1:02 of round 2 (UFC 261)
loses close decisions: 9 of his 10 UFC losses went to the judges, including split decisions to Al Iaquinta, Lorenz Larkin and Benson Henderson
four straight losses to end his UFC career (2020-2023), retired since Apr 2023, age 41
style.summary: A veteran orthodox striker with real power, a sharp counter game and an unusually complete toolkit: body punches, body kicks, low kicks, clinch elbows and knees and the most famous flying knee in UFC history. His takedown defence is good against most of the division (70% career), but the best welterweight wrestlers took him down and held him there, and his output drops sharply in rounds 4 and 5.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1; the engine's target split should come from fighters.json. Career significant attempts go head 0.733 / body 0.156 / leg 0.111 and landed head 0.594 / body 0.240 / leg 0.166; recency-weighted attempts are 0.688 / 0.157 / 0.155 (landed 0.527 / 0.225 / 0.248), because his last three fights leaned on low kicks. League welterweight attempts are about 0.77 / 0.14 / 0.09, so he sends more than average to the body and legs. In the head group the jab, cross and hook lead: 69% of his landed significant strikes are at distance and the Till KO was a punch at distance (UFC Stats); the hook gets extra weight for his counter game, a judgment. Uppercut is 0.12 for his close-range and clinch punching (17% of landed strikes in the clinch). Head kick is small (0.04). Body accuracy is 76% career, high enough that a large share is kicks, so bodykick leads; bodyhook gets 0.35 for the punch finish of Cerrone (UFC Stats: punches to body). Leg strikes are mostly round kicks; calf slightly over inside is a judgment. Knee 0.3 covers the flying knee (Askren) and clinch knees; elbow 0.2 covers the clinch elbow KO of Ferreira and ground elbows. Spinning is 0. UFC Stats does not record technique types, so the within-group split is an analyst judgment from the bout stats in data/raw.

engine_notes.note: Strong fade in five-round fights: pace 1.00 / 1.19 / 0.85 / 0.61 / 0.23 (weights 30, 24, 20, 15, 15 min); three-round curve 1.00 / 0.98 / 0.78. Part of the late drop is being held down by Usman and Covington, so model it as both a stamina fade and lower get-up success late.
Power above the division: 0.46 knockdowns per 15 min career vs a welterweight median of 0.35; 6 KO/TKO wins in the UFC, including a flying knee and a body-punch finish.

Defence splits by opponent type: he absorbs 3.07 significant strikes per minute (median 3.69) and stops 70% of takedowns, but against Usman, Covington and Burns he was controlled for 16:38, 16:14 and 5:41.
